description: Unit test class for DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing header creation, manipulation, validation, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: DefaultDittoHeadersBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder, verifying header creation, validation, JSON serialization, and header manipulation behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test.

methods.name: emptyReturnsEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that an empty DittoHeaders instance has no fields set.

methods.name: setNullCorrelationIdRemovesCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that setting null correlationId removes any existing correlationId.

methods.name: tryToSetEmptyCorrelationId
methods.description: Ensures that setting an empty correlationId throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setNullSchemaVersionRemovesSchemaVersion
methods.description: Verifies that setting null schemaVersion removes it.

methods.name: tryToSetNullAuthSubjects
methods.description: Tests that setting null authorizationSubjects throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullReadSubjects
methods.description: Tests that setting null readSubjects throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that building headers with particular fields produces expected results.

methods.name: constructBuilderFromHeadersWorksExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating a builder from existing headers reproduces the original.

methods.name: buildWithEmptyCorrelationIdThrowsIllegalArgumentException
methods.description: Verifies that setting an empty correlationId during build throws an exception.

methods.name: buildWithEmptyCorrelationIdFromMapThrowsDittoHeaderInvalidException
methods.description: Verifies that constructing headers from a map with empty correlationId raises invalid exception.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfEmptyDittoHeadersIsExpected
methods.description: Checks JSON output of empty headers is an empty object.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfDittoHeadersWithCorrelationIdOnlyIsExpected
methods.description: Validates JSON with only correlationId.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfDittoHeadersWithSchemaVersionOnlyIsExpected
methods.description: Validates JSON with only schemaVersion.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfDittoHeadersWithChannelOnlyIsExpected
methods.description: Verifies JSON with only channel.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfDittoHeadersWithResponseRequiredOnlyIsExpected
methods.description: Checks JSON when responseRequired is specified.

methods.name: jsonRepresentationOfDittoHeadersWithReadSubjectsOnlyIsExpected
methods.description: Validates JSON when only readSubjects are set.

methods.name: tryToSetAuthSubjectsAsGenericKeyValuePairWithInvalidValue
methods.description: Ensures invalid JSON values in auth context headers throw exception.

methods.name: putValidHeaderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that adding a valid header works as intended.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithMapContainingInvalidHeader
methods.description: Checks exception when map contains invalid header values.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithJsonObjectContainingInvalidHeader
methods.description: Checks exception when JSON object has invalid header content.

methods.name: removeValueWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies header removal functions correctly.

methods.name: removePreconditionHeaders
methods.description: Ensures precondition headers can be removed properly.

methods.name: tryToPutMapWithInvalidMessageHeader
methods.description: Checks exception handling for invalid message headers.

methods.name: ensureResponseRequiredIsFalseWhenSet
methods.description: Verifies that responseRequired flag can be explicitly set to false.

methods.name: ensureAllowPolicyLockoutIsFalseWhenSet
methods.description: Checks that allowPolicyLockout can be true.

methods.name: ensureAllowPolicyLockoutIsFalseWhenNotSet
methods.description: Verifies default false behavior for allowPolicyLockout.

methods.name: ensureResponseRequiredStaysFalseEvenWhenAcksAreRequested
methods.description: Ensures responseRequired remains false even with acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: removesDuplicatedAuthSubjects
methods.description: Tests that duplicate authorization subjects are deduplicated properly.

methods.name: putValidMetadata
methods.description: Tests that valid metadata headers can be added.

methods.name: putValidMetadataAsCharSequence
methods.description: Validates adding metadata headers as JSON string.

methods.name: putHeadersContainingValidMetadata
methods.description: Checks that headers with valid metadata entries are accepted.

methods.name: putHeadersContainingInvalidMetadataKey
methods.description: Ensures invalid metadata keys in headers raise exceptions.

methods.name: createBuilderFromMapContainingValidMetadata
methods.description: Tests creating header builder with valid metadata map.

methods.name: createBuilderFromMapContainingInvalidMetadataKey
methods.description: Checks exception on invalid metadata key in map.

methods.name: createBuilderFromMapContainingInvalidMetadataValue
methods.description: Checks exception when invalid metadata value is provided.
